todo_list.title: CRM System Enhancement Roadmap
todo_list.description: Comprehensive to-do list for advanced CRM features and improvements

task.title: Pipeline Analytics Dashboard
task.description: Create comprehensive sales pipeline analytics with conversion rates, average deal size, and time-to-close metrics

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dashboard shows real-time pipeline metrics
Filterable by date range, team member, industry
Visual charts and graphs for data representation
Export functionality for reports

technical_notes.note: Implement Chart.js or Recharts for visualizations
Create new API endpoints for aggregated analytics data
Add date range filtering capabilities

task.title: Team Performance Analytics
task.description: Track individual and team performance metrics including task completion rates, client interaction frequency, and revenue attribution

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Team performance dashboard with key metrics
Individual performance cards for each team member
Comparative analysis between team members
Goal setting and tracking functionality

task.title: Client Engagement Analytics
task.description: Analyze client engagement patterns, communication frequency, and satisfaction indicators

task.title: Global Search Functionality
task.description: Implement comprehensive search across all entities (contacts, companies, leads, projects, tasks) with advanced filtering options

requirements.requirement: Advanced filters (date range, status, assigned user, etc.)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Search returns relevant results from all entities
Search is fast and responsive (sub-second response)
Results are properly categorized and highlighted
Advanced filters work correctly

technical_notes.note: Implement MongoDB text search indexes
Add debounced search input to prevent excessive API calls
Consider implementing Elasticsearch for advanced search capabilities

task.title: Saved Search Filters
task.description: Allow users to save frequently used search criteria and filters for quick access

requirements.requirement: Share saved searches with team members

task.title: Interactive Charts and Graphs
task.description: Add comprehensive data visualization throughout the application using modern charting libraries

requirements.requirement: Interactive chart filters and drill-down capabilities

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Charts are interactive and responsive
Data updates in real-time
Charts are accessible and well-labeled
Export functionality for charts

technical_notes.note: Use Chart.js or D3.js for advanced visualizations
Implement responsive design for mobile compatibility
Add chart export functionality (PNG, PDF, SVG)

task.title: User Authentication System
task.description: Implement comprehensive user authentication with role-based access control

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Secure login/logout functionality
Different access levels based on user roles
Password security requirements enforced
Session timeout and security measures

technical_notes.note: Implement JWT tokens for authentication
Use bcrypt for password hashing
Add middleware for route protection
Consider implementing OAuth integration

task.title: User Preferences & Settings
task.description: Allow users to customize their experience with personal preferences and settings

task.title: Dark Mode Theme
task.description: Implement a dark mode theme option for better user experience and accessibility

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All components render correctly in dark mode
Theme preference is saved and persists
Accessibility standards are maintained

task.title: Responsive Mobile Optimization
task.description: Optimize the interface for mobile devices with touch-friendly interactions

task.title: Accessibility Improvements
task.description: Enhance accessibility features for users with disabilities

task.title: Email Notification System

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Email notifications are sent reliably
Users can configure email preferences

technical_notes.note: Integrate with SendGrid or similar email service
Create email template system
Implement email queue for reliable delivery

task.title: Push Notifications
task.description: Implement browser push notifications for real-time alerts

task.title: Email Integration
task.description: Integrate with email providers to track and log email communications automatically

requirements.requirement: Automatic email logging to contact records

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Emails automatically logged to appropriate contacts
Can send tracked emails from within CRM
Email templates are customizable and reusable

technical_notes.note: Use Gmail API or Microsoft Graph API
Implement OAuth for secure email access
Add email parsing and contact matching logic

Document versions are tracked properly

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Users can create custom workflows visually

technical_notes.note: Implement workflow engine (consider using Node-RED or custom solution)

requirements.requirement: Automatic score updates based on interactions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Accurate sales forecasts within acceptable variance
Clear visualization of forecast trends
Model accuracy improves over time with more data

technical_notes.note: Implement using scikit-learn or TensorFlow
Create separate microservice for ML operations
Add model training and validation pipelines

task.title: Customer Churn Prediction

requirements.requirement: Churn risk scoring for existing clients
Early warning alerts for at-risk accounts
